name: Create a hosted compute network configuration for an organization
description: Create a hosted compute network configuration for an organization Creates a hosted compute network configuration for an organization. POST /orgs/{org}/settings/network-configurations
context:
POST /orgs/{org}/settings/network-configurations
Creates a hosted compute network configuration for an organization. OAuth app tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the `write:network_configurations` scope to use this endpoint.
Required: org (path) — The organization name. The name is not case sensitive.; body (body)

name: Set selected repositories for immutable releases enforcement
description: Set selected repositories for immutable releases enforcement Replaces all repositories that have been selected for immutable releases enforcement in an organization. PUT /orgs/{org}/settings/immutable-releases/repositories
context:
PUT /orgs/{org}/settings/immutable-releases/repositories
Replaces all repositories that have been selected for immutable releases enforcement in an organization. To use this endpoint, the organization immutable releases policy for `enforced_repositories` must be configured to `selected`. OAuth tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the `admin:org` scope to use this endpoint.
Required: org (path) — The organization name. The name is not case sensitive.; body (body)
